content:
Cass: Heads-up from design: users keep saving queries that look fine locally but get silently sampled in prod. I'm proposing a small 'preview' flow that simulates route-level sampling and shows cost + hit estimates. Thoughts?

Noah: Strong yes. We need three things surfaced: estimated hits, token-cost, and staleness of telemetry.

Rhea: UX: default saved-query card shows a tiny status pill: "Live: sampled 20% (est. 1.2k hits/day)". Click opens modal with variant compare.

Cass: Variant compare: No-fallback / Narrow-filters / Sample@x. Each row shows hit_est, token_est, p50/p95 latency. Small copy: "Simulated preview — does not change routing."

Noah: API shape suggestion: POST /api/saved_queries/preview {saved_query_ts, route_id, simulate_variants:boolean, dry_run:true}. Response: {variants:[{name,hit_est,token_est,notes}], last_updated}.

InfraBot: Note: enforce auth + rate-limit. Preview calls should be tagged in telemetry.

Rhea: Visual: add a toggle "Pin model for preview" so QA can see model-specific results without altering route. Pin should be local to preview only.

Noah: Implementation note: store a small opaque ui_hint blob on saved_query (string) so routing is not coupled. Console interprets for preview.

Luke: I'll prototype the modal. Also propose a tiny CTA: "Apply live (runs query against route)" and another: "Save preview as note".

Cass: Agree. Action items: Noah - draft API contract + auth matrix; Luke - mock modal; Rhea - microcopy and telemetry staleness rules; I'll shepherd design sync.

Noah: One gotcha: previews can be expensive. We'll cap simulated sample size and add proxy-side throttling (1/min per user).

Rhea: Also show a tooltip when telemetry last computed, and if >24h show "stale" badge.

Cass: Good catch. Ok team, sync at 3. Thanks!
